character: Theme uses organ-fugue figures, rare in his manualiter works; for clavichord.

subject.quote: The interval of the fifth portato, the rest quasi legato

caveats: Rule applied by me: only G4-C4 (i2-i3, falling fifth) detached; C4-A4 is a sixth and stays joined. Clavichord piece: no dynamic plan. Where the theme ends is not stated; all our notes get the rule.

subject.quote: Legato

rest.dynamics_quote: The keyboards can be coupled by a slight interruption after 23 5/8; the 16' register can be drawn at 27 3/4.

caveats: Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); plan follows the right hand (from 2 1/8: 8",4" to 14 1/2; 8' to 21 1/4; 8",4" to 23 5/8; coupled 8',8",4" to 27 3/4; +16' to 28). Left hand: f 1-16, p 16-19 3/4, f 19-24, ff from 24 5/8. Alto entry of bar 1 taken as left hand (f). Bodky adds that clavichord (pedal clavichord) or even organ might serve as well or better.

character: Very complicated texture; clavichord preferred to bring out every detail.

subject.quote: Portato for the eighths in the theme, nonlegato for diminution, molto tenuto for augmentation of the theme, the rest more leggiero than quasi legato.

rest.articulation_quote: nonlegato for diminution, molto tenuto for augmentation of the theme, the rest more leggiero than quasi legato.
rest.articulation_summary: Diminutions nonlegato, augmentations molto tenuto, other material light, more leggiero than quasi legato.
rest.dynamics_quote: For a performance on the harpsichord, the following registration may be justified

caveats: Portato encoded as detach (short not marked); our 5-note entry may be shorter than his 'theme', last link null. Dynamics come from his harpsichord alternative only (clavichord preferred). Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); right-hand changes at 7 5/8, 11 5/8, 14 5/8, 25 5/8; left hand nearly the same (6 6/8, 11 3/8, 14 5/8, 25 3/16).

subject.quote: Quasi legato; larger intervals leggiero if sixteenths, portato if eighths.

caveats: Rule applied by me, taking 'larger intervals' as a fourth or more (as in the Book I entries): D#3-G#2 (i5-6, fifth) and D#3-G#3 (i15-16, fourth) detached; seconds and thirds joined. Tempo dotted quarter converted to quarter = 90. Clavichord: no dynamic plan.

tempo.as_written: ♩ = ± 80 (see Tempo Table IId, 1 and remarks on p. 127)

character: Dry, 'catholic' (Busoni), vocal theme; Bodky prefers this to Keller's 'rebellious humor'.

subject.quote: The quarters tenuto, the eighths quasi legato

rest.dynamics_quote: The coupler can be applied with a brief interruption at 27 5/8. The 16' register can be drawn during the rest of two eighths in bar 33.

caveats: Printed alla breve, but Bodky (p. 127) makes the quarter the beat: quarter = 80. Tenuto quarters (and the dotted quarter B3) short=false, link not stated; eighth-to-quarter links null. Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); plan is right hand (8' 2-10, 8",4" 10-16, 8' 16-22, 8",4" 22-27, coupled 27-33, 8",4" 33-44, full 44-50); left hand (tenor entry): p 1-20, f 20-27, ff 27-33, f 33-40, ff 40-50. Harpsichord, also organ.

character: 'With heavy emotion' (his Mendelssohn-title analogy for this Prelude and Fugue).

subject.quote: Triplets and sixteenths quasi legato, a "comma" after the fifth eighth, then legato for the descending line.

rest.dynamics_quote: The entire piece "full work." In bar 20, the second and third quarter can and may be played on the upper keyboard (8", 4").

caveats: Fifth eighth counted from the bar start: the triplet run fills eighths 1-4, so the comma falls after A4 (i12). I joined the last triplet to A4 (part of the opening run, my reading). Descending line D5...E4 joined; E4-A4 (i21) null. Full work = ff by Bodky's key; optional 8",4" (f) for bar 20, beats 2-3, left out of the plan.

character: Religious; frequent fourths ('key of Trinity'); best on the (home) organ.

subject.quote: Tenuto e portato, the eighths legato

rest.dynamics_quote: This registration is perhaps somewhat pompous and could be made milder if 8", 4" is substituted for every "full work" and 8' for every 8", 4".

caveats: Tempo is a half-note sign (alla breve), converted to quarter = 160. Quarters and longer notes tenuto e portato: detach, short=false. Eighth pairs joined; eighth into the next quarter null. Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); right hand full 7-30 1/4, 8",4" 30 3/4-55 1/4, full 55 3/4-70; left hand full 1-30 3/4, 8",4" to 53 3/4, full to 70. Milder option (f/p) also offered. Organ preferred.

character: A 'gem for connoisseurs', of less immediate appeal than Book I's.

subject.quote: See Example A6

caveats: Marks read from Ex. A6: dot-and-dash (portato) under D#-D#-D# (i0-2), D#4 i6, the slurred A#-G# pair (i10-11) and the final F#4 (i12); slurs C##-D# (i3-4), F#-E# (i8-9), A#-G# (i10-11, portato slur, joined); dash (tenuto) on G#4 i7. E#4 (i5) is written as a tie across the bar with no mark, so E#4-D#4 is null. The example stops at F#4 (i12), so i12-14 are null. Clavichord: no dynamic plan.

character: Vocal; 'flights of angels'; an instrumental 'Et in terra pax', a Christmas piece.

subject.quote: Molto legato.

rest.articulation_quote: Molto legato. Basically vocal in conception

caveats: Tempo is a half-note sign, converted to quarter = 160. Appendix gives clavichord; on p. 87 he also names this fugue for the home organ. No dynamic plan.

subject.quote: Nonlegato, the prominent quarters in the theme molto portato

rest.articulation_quote: Let us merely mention that the sixteenths after a dotted note have to be played together with the last note of the triplets.
rest.articulation_summary: General nonlegato; dotted figures fitted to the triplets.
rest.dynamics_quote: Registration: (for reasons of simplification we count 12 eighths)

caveats: Tempo is a half-note sign, converted to quarter = 160. All notes detached ('Nonlegato'); quarters (molto portato) short=false. Where the theme ends is not stated, so our whole entry (to i47) gets the rule. Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); right hand 8",4" 1-23 10/12, 8' to 49 10/12, 8",4" to 70 3/4, coupled 8',8",4" from 71 3/8, +16' from 83 3/8; left hand f 6-23, p 24-41, f 41-70, ff 70-86.

character: Light and airy; wing-line theme, perhaps a 'flight of angels'.

subject.quote: Leggiero

caveats: Tempo is a dotted eighth (one per 6/16 bar), converted to quarter = 90. Leggiero encoded as detach, short not marked. Clavichord: no dynamic plan.

subject.quote: Leggiero, no slurring of the upbeat; the two last sixteenths of the first bar could be lightly slurred.

caveats: Upbeat C5 detached; Db5-Bb4 (i4-5) joined (an option: 'could be'). Leggiero = detach, short not marked. Mordent on the first F of the theme advised (ornament, not encoded). Clavichord: no dynamic plan.

character: Bright; makes ample use of the sigh motive in doubled values.

subject.quote: Quarters nonlegato, eighths legato, the falling second of bar 4 and all corresponding places slurred.

caveats: Tempo is a half-note sign, converted to quarter = 160. Quarters F#-C#-D# and G#-B-B detached; eighth-to-eighth links joined; links into/out of the dotted quarters and sixteenths, and eighth-to-quarter, null. The slurred 'falling second of bar 4' could be B3-A#3 (i19-20) or G#3-F#3 (i21-22); not resolved, both null. Opening trill starts on the main note (ornament, not encoded). Clavichord: no dynamic plan.

character: Three-subject fugue: 'too old to be merely playful, too young to be without desire'.

subject.quote: Theme I: all seconds legato, all other intervals portato.

rest.articulation_quote: Theme II: quasi legato, the interval of the fourth portato. Theme III: all sixteenths quasi legato, the eighths portato.
rest.articulation_summary: Theme II quasi legato with fourths portato; theme III sixteenths quasi legato, eighths portato.

caveats: Rule applied by me: seconds joined; thirds C#-A-F#, sixth F#-D, fourth C#-F#, fifth F#-B, third A-F# detached (portato). Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); plan is right hand; left hand: p 1-20, f 20-38, p 38-53, f 53-57, p 57-60, f 60-63, p 63-66, f 66-70. Alto entry of bar 1 taken as left hand (p).

character: Corrente-like 3/8 piece counted in whole bars.

subject.quote: Leggiero for sixteenths

rest.articulation_quote: concerning the eighths, only intervals of a second legato, the others nonlegato.
rest.articulation_summary: Eighths: seconds legato, other intervals nonlegato.

caveats: The subject is all sixteenths, so only 'leggiero' applies (detach, short not marked). Tempo dotted quarter (whole 3/8 bar) converted to quarter = 90. Clavichord: no dynamic plan.

character: Molto feroce; parlando theme, a chorus of Roman soldiers in a 'Calvary' scene.

subject.quote: Molto tenuto e portato, the sixteenths nonlegato

caveats: Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); tenor entry of bar 1 = left hand (f). Plan is right hand; left hand: f 1-17, p 17-20, f 20-24, p 24-28, f 28-32, p 32-36, f 36-40, p 40-45, f 45-67, ff 67-84 (coupled, +16' at 73). Quarters and eighths detached with short=false (tenuto e portato); sixteenths detached.

character: Deep religious feeling (Sanctus symbol); better on the clavichord.

subject.quote: Molto legato

caveats: Bodky gives a harpsichord registration but says the clavichord would intensify the religious background. Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); plan is right hand; left hand: f 6-10, p 10-13, f 13-16, p 16-18, f 18-27, p 27-32, f 32-40, 8',16' 41-46, full from 46.

character: Magnificent double fugue: first theme, second theme, both themes.

subject.quote: Molto legato; the interval of the fourth as in bar 24 and all larger intervals in interludes nonlegato.

rest.articulation_quote: the interval of the fourth as in bar 24 and all larger intervals in interludes nonlegato.
rest.articulation_summary: Theme molto legato; fourths and larger leaps in interludes nonlegato.
rest.dynamics_quote: This registration corresponds exactly with the organization of this magnificent double fugue: fugue on the first theme, fugue on the second theme, fugue on both themes.

caveats: Tempo dotted quarter converted to quarter = 120. Keller's slight slur on the first three eighths of bars 1 and 3 lies inside the general legato, so no break is encoded. Levels: 8" alone = pp (Bodky calls 8" 'the softest register', p. 289), 8' = p and 8",4" = f by Chart 3. Left hand: 8" 5-61, 8' 61-96, 8",4" 97-143.

character: Mild, certainly not energico.

subject.quote: Quasi legato; the notes d' and e' nonlegato, almost staccato

caveats: d' and e' taken by me as the sixteenths D4 (i7) and E4 (i9) before the dotted notes; later D4/E4 left legato. Short, detached after; links into them kept joined. Clavichord: no dynamic plan.

character: One of the most 'explosive' pieces Bach wrote.

subject.quote: Molto marcato e tenuto; all runs quasi legato

caveats: Molto tenuto: short=false, links not stated. 'Marcato' not turned into per-note accents. Full work = ff by Bodky's key.

character: 'Cradle' peace on earth ('Et in terra pax'); a Christmas scene.

subject.quote: Legato throughout; the falling seconds in bars 3 and 4 are slurred in pairs in all reliable copies

rest.articulation_quote: The subdivision of the first twelve notes of the theme into two groups of six notes, as recommended by Keller, seems to us too restless
rest.articulation_summary: Legato throughout, falling-second pairs slurred everywhere.
rest.dynamics_quote: The 4" register is drawn by the left hand in bar 32.

caveats: Pairs slurred: Eb-D, D-C (bar 3), F-Eb, Eb-D (bar 4); I detached each repeated note before a pair (i12, i14, i16, i18, i20, i22). Levels: 8" alone = pp (his 'softest register'), 8' = p, 8",4" = f. Left hand: pp 1-32, p 33-69, f 69-93.

character: The most majestic fugue of volume II; the organ is more fitting.

subject.quote: See Example A7. Only the slurs are quasi legato

rest.dynamics_quote: the Prelude and Fugue in B flat minor, W.K. II, which seems to be too powerful for any harpsichord

caveats: Marks read from Ex. A7: dashes (tenuto) on Bb, C, Eb, A, Bb and F4 (i21); dot-and-dash (portato) on C4 (i6) and Gb4 (i22); a small mark on Db4 (i2), unclear. Slurs over each group of four eighths in bar 3 (i7-10, 11-14, 15-18), over Gb-Eb (i19-20), and over the closing C-Db-Eb (i23-25; C looks beamed with the eighths, unclear). Unslurred notes detached ('only the slurs are quasi legato'). The example ends at Eb4 (i25), so i25-26 are null. Half-note tempo converted to quarter = 160. Levels from Bodky's registration key (Chart 3: f = 8" and 4" (upper manual), p = 8' (lower); coupled 8',8",4" or full work = ff); left hand: ff 5-26, f 27-41, ff 42-66, f 67-80, ff 80-101.

character: Of lesser 'height' than the B flat minor fugue, so less sound.

subject.quote: Tenuto e quasi legato

rest.dynamics_quote: we suggest deducting the 8' register from the "full work."

caveats: Half-note tempo converted to quarter = 160. Tenuto e quasi legato encoded as join with short=false. Levels: 8",4",16' coupled (full work minus 8') = ff, 8",4" = f (Bodky's key). Left hand: ff 1-27, f 27-47, ff 48-60, f 60-74, ff 75-104.

character: Passepied; an unassuming 'Ausklang' (final sound) for the whole collection.

subject.quote: The upbeat eighth staccato; in the first bar, the first two notes slurred, the last eighth staccato; staccato, too, throughout bars 3 and 4 and first eighth of bar 5; all the rest legato.

caveats: Bar 1 = D4 B3 A#3 after the upbeat F#4. Bar 2 and bar 5 from i16 are legato; F#4-G4 (i8-9) detached because G4 is staccato. Bodky rejects Keller's legato upbeat (p. 219: a one-note upbeat is never slurred). Tempo dotted quarter (whole 3/8 bar) converted to quarter = 90. Clavichord: no dynamic plan.
